key_insights.summary: The budget-aware partial topology achieved full coverage (all agents covered) but all answers were wrong (full_coverage_wrong_answer_rate=1.0). This indicates that the communication structure allowed agents to reach a consensus on an incorrect answer, likely due to insufficient diversity or verification.
key_insights.title: Budget-aware partial topology leads to full coverage but zero accuracy

key_insights.falsification_test: Run with min_protocol_steps=3 and observe if accuracy improves.

recommended_actions: Set min_protocol_steps=3 in planner for this condition bucket.
key_insights.summary: The topology used only 2 protocol steps and 7 messages on average, which is low for 8 agents on 1024-sized array. This suggests that agents did not have enough communication rounds to correct errors, leading to a consensus on wrong answers.
key_insights.title: Low protocol steps and messages correlate with wrong answers despite full coverage

key_insights.falsification_test: Run with budget_first objective and check if accuracy is acceptable.

operation_recommendations.expected_effect: Improve accuracy while keeping cost moderate.
operation_recommendations.instruction: For balanced objective, use at least 2 sinks to ensure accuracy is not sacrificed.

recommended_actions: Restrict budget-aware topologies to budget_first objective only.
key_insights.summary: The topology was designed for budget awareness but the objective was balanced. The low cost (mean tokens 16424) came at the expense of accuracy (RMSE 15.81). This suggests a tradeoff where budget-aware structures sacrifice accuracy too much for balanced objectives.
key_insights.title: Budget-aware partial topology may be unsuitable for balanced objective

operation_recommendations.instruction: Select the agent with highest local accuracy as the sink, or use a separate verification agent as sink.

operation_recommendations.expected_effect: Enable error detection and correction by tracking data lineage.
operation_recommendations.instruction: Add provenance metadata to each message so that the sink can trace the origin of values and detect inconsistencies.

key_insights.summary: The sparse peer exchange topology achieved full coverage (mean final coverage 0.5625, but full_coverage_wrong_answer_rate=1.0) meaning all agents were reached but all final answers were incorrect. This suggests that the sparse exchange structure propagated errors without any verification or correction mechanism.
key_insights.title: Sparse peer exchange leads to full coverage but zero accuracy due to error propagation

key_insights.falsification_test: Compare accuracy with fan-in=3 vs fan-in=1 at sink.

operation_recommendations.expected_effect: Increase redundancy and reduce error propagation.
operation_recommendations.instruction: Set minimum fan-in for sink to 3 to ensure multiple inputs are merged.

operation_recommendations.expected_effect: Improve accuracy by combining multiple estimates with weighting.
operation_recommendations.instruction: Use a more sophisticated merge that includes confidence weighting or majority voting instead of llm_full_merge.

key_insights.summary: With only 4 mean candidate count and 20 messages, the sparse peer exchange has low redundancy. Errors from early agents propagate to later agents without correction, leading to uniformly wrong final answers.
key_insights.title: Low fan-in and no verification cause error amplification in sparse exchange

key_insights.falsification_test: Test sparse peer exchange on array_size=256 and check if accuracy improves.

operation_recommendations.expected_effect: Prevent catastrophic accuracy loss on large arrays.
operation_recommendations.instruction: Avoid sparse peer exchange for array_size > 512; use hierarchical or audit-based topologies instead.

recommended_actions: Restrict sparse peer exchange to small arrays
key_insights.summary: For array size 1024, the sparse exchange topology fails completely (RMSE 13.39). This suggests that for large arrays, sparse communication without verification is insufficient to aggregate accurate information.
key_insights.title: Sparse peer exchange may be unsuitable for large arrays without verification steps
